answer: Each identity locks a bond before it can act, so launching many clones becomes expensive rather than free. The system watches for duplicate behavior: when identical accounts echo the same signal, it treats that mirror as evidence of one operator behind many masks. Detection triggers slashing, seizing the full deposit and burning it, which shortens the attacker’s horizon by making a sybil farm lose more than it can gain. Honest participants recover their bond; clones do not.
